subcategories.name: Sword
subcategories.description: A bladed weapon with a single or double edge, ranging from short swords to long blades.

subcategories.name: Spear
subcategories.description: A polearm with a pointed tip, used for thrusting and throwing.

subcategories.name: Bow
subcategories.description: A ranged weapon that launches arrows.

subcategories.name: Arrow
subcategories.description: Projectile fired from a bow, with a pointed tip and fletched tail.

subcategories.name: Axe
subcategories.description: A chopping tool and weapon with a heavy blade mounted on a handle.

subcategories.name: Mace
subcategories.description: A blunt weapon with a heavy spiked or studded head on a handle.

subcategories.name: Lance
subcategories.description: A long polearm used primarily by mounted cavalry for charging.

subcategories.name: Dagger
subcategories.description: A short blade weapon, easily concealable and useful for close combat.

subcategories.name: Pike
subcategories.description: A longer version of the spear with a small pointed head.

subcategories.name: Crossbow
subcategories.description: A mechanical bow that shoots bolts using a trigger mechanism.

subcategories.name: Halberd
subcategories.description: A polearm combining an axe blade, pike point, and hook or spike.

subcategories.name: Flail
subcategories.description: A handle with a chain or leather strap attached to a weighted or spiked ball.

subcategories.name: Hammer
subcategories.description: A heavy striking weapon with a broad head for crushing.

subcategories.name: Club
subcategories.description: A simple, heavy wooden weapon.

subcategories.name: Scimitar
subcategories.description: A curved, single-edged sword originating from the Middle East and Asia.

subcategories.name: Katana
subcategories.description: A Japanese curved sword, traditionally used by samurai.

subcategories.name: Rapier
subcategories.description: A thin, flexible blade designed for thrusting.

subcategories.name: Broadsword
subcategories.description: A wide-bladed sword for cutting and thrusting.

subcategories.name: Fauchard
subcategories.description: A medieval polearm with a curved blade, used by peasants and soldiers.

subcategories.name: Guisarme
subcategories.description: A polearm featuring hooks, blades, and points for versatile combat.

subcategories.name: Glaive
subcategories.description: A polearm with a large, single-edged blade mounted on a shaft.

subcategories.name: Voulge
subcategories.description: A polearm with an axe-like blade attached to a long handle.

subcategories.name: Morgenstern
subcategories.description: A German spiked ball weapon on a handle (morning star).

subcategories.name: Trident
subcategories.description: A three-pronged spear-like weapon, effective against multiple opponents.

subcategories.name: Jian
subcategories.description: A Chinese straight double-edged sword with a long history.

subcategories.name: Naginata
subcategories.description: A Japanese polearm with a curved blade at the end.

subcategories.name: War Pick
subcategories.description: A pointed hammer designed to pierce and crush armor.

subcategories.name: Billhook
subcategories.description: A curved hooked polearm used for cutting and pulling.

subcategories.name: Staff
subcategories.description: A long pole used to channel magic or as a melee weapon.

subcategories.name: Wand
subcategories.description: A short magical implement to direct spells and energy.

subcategories.name: Rune Blade
subcategories.description: A sword inscribed with magical runes granting special powers.

subcategories.name: Scepter
subcategories.description: A magical staff or ornamental weapon channeling supernatural force.

subcategories.name: Grimoire
subcategories.description: A magical tome serving as both weapon and spell source.

subcategories.name: Blade
subcategories.description: A dark or corrupted magical sword with unpredictable effects.

subcategories.name: Greatsword
subcategories.description: A large two-handed fantasy sword often wielded by heroes.

subcategories.name: Talisman
subcategories.description: A magical charm or object providing protection and power.

subcategories.name: Amulet
subcategories.description: An enchanted ornament granting the wearer magical abilities.

subcategories.name: Orb
subcategories.description: A magical sphere used to cast powerful spells or summon forces.

subcategories.name: Tome
subcategories.description: An ancient magical book containing forbidden or powerful knowledge.

subcategories.name: Crown
subcategories.description: A magical regal artifact that commands power and authority.
